integrity: The character-symmetrization proof establishes the universal claim. The accompanying standalone exact arithmetic script checks the relevant finite-group spectrum but is not an enumeration of all stochastic matrices.
scientific_limitations: One-step Euclidean norm only; uniform chain is uniquely optimal among central class-measure convolutions, not proven unique among all chains. Does not optimize multistep varying kernels or total variation. Historical priority not independently established; some plausible specialized papers were inaccessible in full text.
title: Sharp one-step Fourier mixing on the odd-rotation icosahedral Cayley network
